verification.runtime_check: I started a uvicorn server from a script outside the project (scratchpad/v9/server.py, port 8792) with a temp DB and a temp uploads directory, and seeded one post with a photo. I drove headless Chrome (port 9344, temp profile) over CDP for each of light and dark. In each theme I moved the mouse away to measure rest, moved it onto .delete-button for hover, and held mousePressed for pressed. I then released with the DELETE held by Fetch interception to measure busy, and failed the request to measure the restored state. The server and Chrome were stopped afterwards.
verification.self_critique: I measured only the .delete-button on a white (light) and black (dark) page background, not inside every container (edit forms, error areas). Contrast is my own sRGB WCAG compositing, sampled 250ms after the pointer event. I did not re-run the screenshots or the other criteria, relying on the one-value diff and the mtimes. No git exists, so "only one value changed" is inferred from the implementation record and from style.css being the only file newer than iteration 1. The before-snapshot was taken after the style.css edit, so it proves only that my run changed nothing. It does not prove that style.css is otherwise identical to iteration 1.
